text: poetry. Here's a little one for you. In
a world of dreams and delight, where
stars above shine so bright with words I
paint a vivid scene expressing emotions
soft and serene. Poems are wonderful.
They touch the heart. They speak of
love, of longing, and art. So if ever
you crave a verse or two, just ask and
